domains.title: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications

coverage_policy.EVIDENCED: Substantial repository evidence directly exercises the task's core engineering concerns.
coverage_policy.PARTIAL: Repository evidence exercises part of the task; important examples or subskills remain study-only.
coverage_policy.STUDY_ONLY: No product-backed implementation evidence is claimed for this task.

task_coverage.title: Analyze requirements and design GenAI solutions.
task_coverage.notes: Architecture, PoC decisions, retained/rejected alternatives, and explicit authority boundaries are documented across the project.

task_coverage.title: Select and configure FMs.
task_coverage.notes: OpsLens measures and selects between bounded model topologies, but does not implement FM customization lifecycle or provisioned-throughput scenarios.

task_coverage.title: Implement data validation and processing pipelines for FM consumption.
task_coverage.notes: The canonical knowledge corpus is normalized, content-addressed, source-bound, and admitted before Bedrock ingestion.

task_coverage.title: Design and implement vector store solutions.
task_coverage.notes: The retained knowledge path uses Bedrock Knowledge Bases with Amazon S3 Vectors and explicit metadata/provenance boundaries.

task_coverage.title: Design retrieval mechanisms for FM augmentation.
task_coverage.notes: OpsLens implements independently measurable Retrieve-based RAG and hybrid structured/semantic routing with explicit comparability and grounding evaluation.

task_coverage.title: Implement prompt engineering strategies and governance for FM interactions.
task_coverage.notes: Prompt shape, output contracts, token ceilings, and deterministic post-validation are implemented; Bedrock Prompt Management and Guardrails are not forced into the product without a concrete need.

task_coverage.title: Implement agentic AI solutions and tool integrations.
task_coverage.notes: Single-agent, multi-agent handoff, MCP, and A2A paths keep model/tool proposals separate from deterministic authorization and result admission.

task_coverage.title: Implement model deployment strategies.
task_coverage.notes: OpsLens compares direct Bedrock reasoning with a bounded AgentCore hosting experiment, but does not cover SageMaker custom-model deployment or provisioned throughput.

task_coverage.title: Design and implement enterprise integration architectures.
task_coverage.notes: The platform uses event-driven AWS integration, least-privilege CI/CD identities, deterministic service boundaries, and explicit interoperability contracts.

task_coverage.title: Implement FM API integrations.
task_coverage.notes: Bedrock Converse integrations include bounded requests, structured response handling, retry/failure semantics, inference profiles, and evidence capture.

task_coverage.title: Implement application integration patterns and development tools.
task_coverage.notes: API/application integration, CI quality gates, and operational tooling are exercised; UI-oriented and no-code integration examples are not a core OpsLens requirement.

task_coverage.title: Implement input and output safety controls.
task_coverage.notes: Input bounds, indirect prompt-injection defenses, structured output admission, forged-result rejection, and adversarial regressions are retained.

task_coverage.title: Implement data security and privacy controls.
task_coverage.notes: Least-privilege IAM and content-minimized telemetry are implemented; PII-detection services and private-network deployment patterns are study topics rather than current product requirements.

task_coverage.title: Implement AI governance and compliance mechanisms.
task_coverage.notes: ADRs, source provenance, immutable evidence, CI enforcement, authority boundaries, and explicit deferrals create a verifiable governance trail.

task_coverage.title: Implement responsible AI principles.
task_coverage.notes: Groundedness, unsupported-claim detection, negative-result retention, and abstention are exercised; broader fairness/bias assessment is not a core current OpsLens workload.

task_coverage.title: Implement cost optimization and resource efficiency strategies.
task_coverage.notes: Token, Athena scan, Scheduler retry/event-age, and historical experiment-cost evidence are separated into observed/derived/configured/unmeasured boundaries.

task_coverage.title: Optimize application performance.
task_coverage.notes: Measured quality, token, latency, and cost comparisons are used to reject unnecessary topology complexity.

task_coverage.title: Implement monitoring systems for GenAI applications.
task_coverage.notes: CloudWatch/X-Ray-style operational evidence and content-minimized telemetry contracts are retained with explicit cardinality and privacy controls.

task_coverage.title: Implement evaluation systems for GenAI.
task_coverage.notes: OpsLens evaluates retrieval, groundedness, agent reasoning, adversarial boundaries, latency, tokens, and cost while preserving comparability semantics.

task_coverage.title: Troubleshoot GenAI applications.
task_coverage.notes: Failure-path labs, typed error boundaries, logs/traces/metrics, fail-closed behavior, and operational recovery are exercised throughout the project.

study_only_topics.reason: Not added solely for exam coverage; current deterministic and evaluation controls remain the product-backed safety path.

study_only_topics.topic: Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management and Prompt Flows
study_only_topics.reason: Prompt templates are currently code-owned and versioned; managed prompt services require a concrete product need before adoption.

study_only_topics.topic: SageMaker custom FM training/fine-tuning and Model Registry
study_only_topics.reason: Custom-model development and training are not required by the retained OpsLens workload.
Current bounded lab traffic does not justify reserved model capacity.

study_only_topics.topic: PII discovery with Macie or Comprehend
study_only_topics.reason: OpsLens minimizes sensitive payload capture; dedicated PII services remain study-only until a real data-classification need exists.
No public HTTP runtime is retained, so public-edge controls are not manufactured for certification coverage.
